title: Create src/tui/components/ProgressBar.tsx — Unicode block progress bar
description: Create a reusable Ink component that renders a Unicode block progress bar. Bar width scales to terminal width. Accepts percent, complete, and total props.
acceptanceCriteria: ProgressBar renders correct fill ratio for 0%, 50%, 100% inputs
Does not throw when terminal width is undefined
Bar uses █ for filled and ░ for empty

steps.details: Create the file. Define props: { percent: number; complete: number; total: number; width?: number }

const termWidth = process.stdout.columns || 80; const barWidth = (props.width || Math.min(termWidth - 20, 40)); const filled = Math.round(barWidth * props.percent / 100); const empty = barWidth - filled.

technicalNotes: process.stdout.columns can be undefined in non-TTY contexts (pipes, CI) — always provide a fallback value
